name: v0.1.2
body:

* Agent FFI integration by @zanderjiang in https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-bench/pull/119

* Add Claude Code GitHub Workflow by @yzh119 in https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-bench/pull/137
